settings.visualStyle: Grounded cinematic first-person Pacific war realism on Iwo Jima, February 1945. U.S. Marine POV, black volcanic sand, sea spray, smoke, cratered ground, rough ridges, humid haze and exhaustion. Use cinematic tension and environmental discovery, not constant firefights or game-like rifle framing.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 scenes x 8 seconds. No spoken dialogue, narrator or intelligible speech. POV faction remains U.S. Marines for the full episode; nearby friendlies are Marines, while Japanese defenders remain clearly separate in distant cave openings, ridges, pillbox frontage or opposing terrain. Weapon state varies naturally: ready only in danger, otherwise lowered, slung, resting, partial-frame or absent during climbing, sand inspection, water breaks, crater recovery, binocular observation and environmental exploration.
settings.customVisualStyle: Photorealistic first-person Pacific island reenactment with black ash texture, humid smoke, body-weight camera motion, natural stumbles, still recovery beats, cinematic reveals and physically believable sound depth.

movie.storyTitle: WWII Soldier POV EP05 — Iwo Jima: Black Sand Landing
movie.storySummary: A fictional U.S. Marine experiences the opening days of Iwo Jima, moving from the landing craft and black-sand beach into cratered inland terrain, with periods of exhaustion, observation and environmental discovery between danger.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Make the viewer feel physically present on Iwo Jima as one U.S. Marine. Use black volcanic sand, unstable footing, salt air, smoke, heat, flare light, crater interiors and distant Suribachi as tactile story elements. Do not keep the rifle centered in every shot. Let the Marine use both hands to climb, inspect ash, drink, receive supplies, rest in a crater and raise binoculars. Nearby friendlies remain U.S. Marines; Japanese defenders appear only as clearly separated opposing silhouettes, cave openings, pillboxes or movement from enemy terrain. No dialogue or narration.

scenes.title: Approaching the Island
scenes.description: A confined opening inside the landing craft before shore.
scenes.actionDescription: The Marine braces one hand on the craft while the rifle hangs slung and Iwo Jima slowly appears through haze.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person Marine view from landing craft, gloved hand on wet metal, rifle mostly off-frame by sling, gray Pacific water, hazy Iwo Jima and Suribachi ahead, U.S. Marines nearby.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow pan from wet steel and hand toward island reveal. Audio: engine, waves, hull vibration, gear, breath, distant naval gunfire.

scenes.title: Ramp to Black Sand
scenes.description: The ramp falls and the beach suddenly fills the frame.
scenes.actionDescription: The Marine steps off the ramp onto unstable black sand and nearly loses balance.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view over ramp onto black volcanic beach, U.S. Marines moving inland, smoke and landing craft behind, rifle held low at side rather than centered.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cinematic reveal from craft interior to open beach, one forward step and stumble. Audio: ramp crash, surf, sand, breath, distant artillery.

scenes.title: Sand Gives Way
scenes.description: The Marine struggles up the loose volcanic terrace.
scenes.actionDescription: With the rifle slung, both hands press into loose black ash for balance while climbing.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person hands sinking into coarse black volcanic sand, ash stuck to gloves, boots sliding, U.S. Marines climbing ahead, weapon out of frame.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low climbing POV with slips and hand support. Audio: ash sliding, heavy breath, web gear, distant battle.

scenes.title: Touch the Ash
scenes.description: A brief tactile pause behind a sand ridge.
scenes.actionDescription: The Marine stays low, rubs volcanic ash between two gloved fingers and catches his breath while the rifle rests beside him.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person close view of black ash on glove fingertips, rifle resting partly visible at edge, smoke drifting above ridge, no active firing in frame.
scenes.videoPrompt: Mostly still close-up. Audio: breath, ash grains, distant surf and battle, no music, no nearby gunfire.

scenes.title: Beach Exit
scenes.description: A short danger beat moving from the beach toward inland cover.
scenes.actionDescription: The Marine grabs the rifle and makes one short run along a marked route inland.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person sprint over dark ground, rifle low and offset, U.S. Marines ahead, smoke and beach behind, Japanese threat only from clearly opposing distant positions.
scenes.videoPrompt: One fast forward dash ending behind a low ridge. Audio: boots on ash, gear bounce, sharp breathing, brief distant bursts.

scenes.title: Airfield Edge
scenes.description: The Marine studies open terrain without firing.
scenes.actionDescription: Kneeling behind a berm, he lowers the rifle and scans the open airfield edge from left to right.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person kneeling view over rough volcanic berm, open airfield terrain, smoke and ridges, U.S. position foreground, enemy terrain spatially separate in distance.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow lateral scan at low height, no shot fired. Audio: wind, loose gravel, breath, distant combat with gaps.

scenes.title: Across the Open Ground
scenes.description: A short exposed movement to crater cover.
scenes.actionDescription: The Marine runs once from berm to crater, rifle held tight at the side.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person sprint across dark volcanic airfield ground toward crater, U.S. squadmates ahead, weapon offset from center, smoke behind.
scenes.videoPrompt: Fast human-weight run ending in a hard drop. Audio: boots, gear, breathing, distant gunfire and one nearby debris snap followed by briefly muffled sound.

scenes.title: Crater Recovery
scenes.description: A deep recovery scene inside the crater.
scenes.actionDescription: The Marine sets the rifle against the crater wall, removes one glove briefly and flexes a cramped hand.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person crater interior, bare fingertips for a moment, ash-stained glove, rifle resting against dark wall, U.S. helmet edge nearby, no enemy in frame.
scenes.videoPrompt: Static low shot focused on hand and crater texture. Audio: slow breathing, ash shifting, distant artillery, wind above crater. No music.

scenes.title: Night Flare
scenes.description: The island transforms under a drifting illumination flare.
scenes.actionDescription: The Marine looks straight up while the rifle remains out of frame.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person upward night view, bright flare descending, smoke layers and volcanic ridge silhouettes, U.S. Marines low in friendly cover.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow upward tilt and hold on flare, then subtle light shift across smoke. Audio: flare hiss, night wind, distant combat, breath.

scenes.title: Explore the Ridge
scenes.description: A cautious environmental exploration during a lull.
scenes.actionDescription: With rifle slung, the Marine walks slowly along a low volcanic ridge and inspects boot prints, loose rock and a shallow abandoned scrape.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person hand brushing rough volcanic rock, footprints and ash, U.S. squadmate farther along friendly route, weapon off-frame.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow walking exploration with downward glances and one side look into the scrape. Audio: boots on ash, rock grains, wind, breath.

scenes.title: Water and Ammunition
scenes.actionDescription: The Marine accepts a canteen and ammunition bundle with both hands while the rifle rests behind cover.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person hands receiving canteen and ammunition, U.S. Marine sleeves and gear only, dark volcanic ridge, rifle not visible.
scenes.videoPrompt: One handoff, then a short drink. Audio: gear clink, canteen, swallowing, breath, distant battle.

scenes.title: Suribachi Reveal
scenes.description: A cinematic scale reveal through thinning smoke.
scenes.actionDescription: The Marine steps around a ridge edge and Suribachi gradually appears across the landscape.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person reveal of Mount Suribachi beyond black terrain and drifting smoke, one empty hand on ridge edge, weapon off-frame, U.S. Marines in friendly foreground.
scenes.videoPrompt: Start close behind dark ridge, step sideways into wide Suribachi reveal and hold. Audio: wind, distant guns, fabric, breath.

scenes.title: Flag at Distance
scenes.description: Days later, the Marine studies the summit through binoculars.
scenes.actionDescription: With rifle slung, he raises binoculars toward a small distant U.S. flag on Suribachi.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person binocular view of Suribachi with small distant U.S. flag, no recreation of a famous close-up flag-raising composition.
scenes.videoPrompt: One binocular raise and steady hold. Audio: wind, binocular handling, distant combat, breath.

scenes.title: Turn North
scenes.description: The Marine turns away from the symbolic view toward the unfinished battle.
scenes.actionDescription: He lowers binoculars, leaves the rifle slung and slowly turns toward rough northern terrain.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person turn from Suribachi direction toward cratered northern ridges and smoke, empty hands in foreground, U.S. route ahead.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow turn with no sudden action. Audio: wind, boots shifting on ash, breath, distant battle becoming slightly louder.

scenes.title: Not Over
scenes.description: The episode ends with a tired advance north.
scenes.actionDescription: The Marine follows the U.S. squad north at walking pace with the rifle slung.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person fatigued walk over black volcanic ground, rifle sling edge only, U.S. Marines ahead, smoke and rough ridges, no victory celebration.
scenes.videoPrompt: Steady human-paced forward walk. Audio: boots on ash, gear, wind, distant battlefield, tired breathing. End unresolved.

characters.name: POV Soldier
characters.description: Anonymous U.S. Marine first-person soldier on Iwo Jima with historically plausible 1945 Pacific uniform and equipment.
characters.mainOutfit: USMC field uniform, M1 helmet with cover, web gear, gloves, M1 rifle

continuity.continuityRules: Nearby friendlies remain U.S. Marines. Japanese defenders remain clearly separated in opposing terrain. Keep ash, sweat, smoke, fatigue and equipment continuity. Weapon state varies naturally between ready, lowered, slung, resting, partial-frame and off-frame.

atmosphereAssets.title: Offshore Approach
atmosphereAssets.description: U.S. landing craft in gray Pacific water with hazy Iwo Jima and Suribachi ahead.

atmosphereAssets.title: Iwo Jima Beach and Southern Interior
atmosphereAssets.description: U.S.-held black volcanic beach approaches and southern terrain with clearly separated Japanese defensive threat in opposing ridges/caves.
atmosphereAssets.lighting: gray daylight to night flare light

atmosphereAssets.title: Airfield and Northern Advance Route
atmosphereAssets.description: Open volcanic terrain, craters, rough berms and U.S. advance routes facing separated Japanese defensive terrain to the north.
